acip: YANG KHO NA RE, DNGOS PO'I RGYU DANG , DNGOS PO'I 'BRAS BU'I GZHI MTHUN YOD PAR THAL, DNGOS PO'I RGYUR GYUR PA'I DNGOS PO'I 'BRAS BU YOD PA'I PHYIR ZER NA,
wylie: yang kho na re, dngos po'i rgyu dang , dngos po'i 'bras bu'i gzhi mthun yod par thal, dngos po'i rgyur gyur pa'i dngos po'i 'bras bu yod pa'i phyir zer na
english: Suppose someone comes once more, and makes the following claim: Isn't it the case, that there does exist one thing which can be both (1) the cause of a working thing and (2) a result of the working thing? Because there does exist the result of a working thing that serves as the cause of a working thing.
